column1: # The first-aid cabinets in the store and the staffroom (TODO W31, 4. 11.): opened and emptied in one go. Of two takes this one (opening, pills, gauze in one run; the other had a dead second in the middle), normalised to -23 LUFS.

column4: A small old enamelled metal first-aid cabinet on a wall: its little door unlatched with a click and swung open on a squeaky hinge, then a few pills rattling in a small glass bottle and a roll of gauze bandage pulled out with a papery rustle, close, dry, in a quiet small storeroom, no voices, no music.
